notes.title: Controller Update - EA 0.5.22
notes.notes:
[h1]Controller Support[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721131/5af5774e9b93133252a4960e07e33f513f9a0fa7.png[/img]
Controller support is now in the testing phase! Plug in your favourite Xbox or PlayStation controller and give it a go.

As this is the first version of controller support, please leave your feedback inside the [url=https://discord.gg/X5kdyhAXVu]Discord server[/url] for how we can improve it.

With controller support added, the Steamdeck can now run the game much better. We're still working on an update to ensure the Steamdeck runs the game at native resolution with the correct control icons. Look out for this update soon.


[h1]1.0 Launch[/h1]
The 1.0 launch date will be announced next week! It's been a wild ride since November, and I'm incredibly grateful for the positive reception the game has had. 

I want to clarify that even after the 1.0 launch, I will continue to fix any new bugs you guys might uncover and implement new feedback for the game from the influx of new players.

Thank you for your continued support. I literally wouldn't be able to do this without you guys 🙏


[h1]I Need Your Help[/h1]
This week, I came to find out that my X account has been wrongfully suspended for inauthentic behaviour, with 9.5K followers and 2-factor authentication enabled. 

I reached out to appeal the suspension daily and still haven't heard back from them.

I have been sharing my progress on X/Twitter for 7 years, and it has become one of my best social media platforms.

It would mean a lot to me if you could make a post on X mentioning @Support and @DeadUnicornInc about the false suspension. 

I appreciate your help!

[h1]Other Changes[/h1]

[*] Fixed a bug where you could use explosives in the Outpost
[*] Fixed a bug where toggle sprint would reset when entering buildings

[*] Fixed a bug where sometimes the player would spawn in a tree in Eden
[*] Fixed a bug where sometimes trading would allow you to go into debt
[*] Fixed a bug where the companion input hints would show without a companion
[/list]
[h2]Changes[/h2]

[*] Added Steam Cloud support
[*] Added better support for Steamdeck (Please leave any feedback you might have for Steamdeck)
[*] Added controller support
[*] Added Nova Piercer laser gun

See you guys in the next update, and be sure to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fform.jotform.com%2F242873875699279]report any new bugs[/url] you might encounter!

notes.title: Explosives Update - EA 0.5.2
notes.notes:
[h1]Grenades[/h1]
Grenades can be looted, purchased or crafted.

There are currently 3 types of grenades:
1. Impact Grenade (typical grenade)
2. Seeker Grenade (creates a small drone that seeks the nearest target)
3. Hornet Grenade (creates a swarm of cyber hornets)

Grenades can be used from the inventory or equipped on the hotbar.

[h1]Rep Rewards[/h1]
NPCs now have a new page: Rep Rewards.

You can redeem Rep Rewards using Rep Tokens. Every time you increase your reputation rank, you'll gain a rep token for that NPC.

You can gain reputation by purchasing items or completing quests for the given NPC.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where sometimes placing an object for a quest would make the player stuck
[/list]
[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated daily credits for traders
[*] Added Rep Rewards for NPCs
[*] Added new scrap item: Scrap Explosives
[*] Added Rep Tokens for NPCs. Rep Tokens can be spent on items and improving trading. Gain Rep Tokens for increasing your reputation.
[*] Removed reputation from some NPCs
[*] Removed trading from some NPCs in favor of Rep Rewards
[*] Added animation for placing explosives
[*] Added new grenade items: Impact Grenade, Seeker Grenade, and Hornet Grenade. Grenades can be equipped on your hotbar.
[*] Added new explosive item: Land Mine
[*] Added new laser SMG: Voidrunner
[*] Added new 9x19mm pistol: AZ-57
[*] Added cosmetic clothing slots. Cosmetic slots can only be accessed in the Outpost.
[*] Buffed both Curse Bringer SMGs
[/list]

See you guys in the next update, and be sure to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fform.jotform.com%2F242873875699279]report any new bugs[/url] you might encounter!

notes.title: Companion Update - EA 0.4.24
notes.notes:
[h1]Player Companions[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721131/a768deeb9dcf22fcda8ac392f7dca266b69cb087.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721131/df8fd6df39535c55bb8e897fc5eeadfb3f0e924f.png[/img]

A new NPC has arrived in the Outpost, Ash, the Drone Specialist. He will manage all your drone companions and sell you Drone Repair Kits.

Crafting the first mk. 1 drone companion requires drone blueprints, which can only be looted from rare or legendary chests.

The first drone companion to be added is the K9 drone, a rugged robotic dog built to carry gear and equipped with a swivelling auto-turret for precise combat support.

[h1]Mech Enemies[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721131/cd28aa128bd09e97e58b1cd141819048128344a0.png[/img]

A new enemy type can now be found on all maps: Mechs. Mechs can spawn randomly throughout the map as well as in specific locations. The faction of the mech will depend on the map/location. Mechs will increase in difficulty depending on the map.

Mechs are slow-moving, hard-hitting enemies who fire homing rockets that cut through armor protection.

Level 3 or higher bounty targets will now spawn with a Mech to make defeating them more challenging and rewarding.

[h1]Coming Soon[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721131/89492771cdccc86648c6f9041f71ffedff592c39.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721131/6a80cd3507b2884deaede1737f8f55b4442a9a89.png[/img]

The fourth map, Frostreach, will be arriving by Christmas. It's a snow-themed map with new enemies, new locations, and seven new quests.

[h1]Other Changes[/h1]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the Cyberdrive had no value
[*] Fixed a bug where you could scrap and unload weapons inside the workbench
[*] Fixed a bug where Luca's house didn't have collisions
[*] Fixed a bug where certain weapon skill challenges couldn't be completed
[/list]
[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added player companion drone
[*] Added new NPC, Ash, to the Outpost. Ash handles drone companion crafting/upgrading
[*] Added new item, Companion Blueprints. Blueprints have a low chance to be found in rare and legendary chests
[*] Added new item, Drone Repair Kit. Drone repair kits can be purchased, crafted, or looted
[*] Added new item, Drone Core. Can be used to upgrade drones and craft Drone Repair Kits
[*] Added new item, High Grade Remote Explosives
[*] Added new enemy type, Mech. Mechs will belong to different factions depending on the map and spawn in randomized locations
[*] Added new Bounty Quest location for each map
[*] Updated bounty targets level 3 and above  will now spawn with a Mech
[*] Updated the First Aid Case stack (1 > 2) and slot space (4 > 2)
[*] Updated the First Aid Kit stack (1 > 2)
[*] Updated Low-Grade Remote Explosives stack (1 > 3)
[*] Updated E4 Carbine sounds
[*] Updated Nectar sounds, fire rate (1000 > 1100), and damage (10 > 11)
[*] Updated wounds now display on your health bar, indicating how much health they are reducing
[*] You can now re-acquire Dustpiercer Prototype and Dustpiercer from Kane

See you guys in the next update, and be sure to report any new bugs you might encounter!

notes.title: Blood Running Development Roadmap + Demo Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Exciting News[/h1]
Hello everyone, Jesse Here. It's been too long since this game was updated! Today, I'm announcing the upcoming development roadmap for Blood Running and notes about the demo update that was launched today.

[h2]Development Roadmap[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721131/c6c467bb59efa56b0cef92c0b7f0995dae917746.png[/img]

I'm excited to launch Blood Running into early access in Q4 2024, with plans to release 1.0 in early 2025. This has been a long journey, and I can't wait for you guys to get your hands on more of the game's content!

[h2]Demo Update[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721131/0496ffc53f6d4d0ae36e6488b9e77ce13e64dd3e.png[/img]

Open Steam and you'll find a brand new update for the Blood Running demo! It adds new items, guns, armour, artwork, and QOL improvements.


[b]Below are some of the more noticeable changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Enemies will now trust you until you attack if you are wearing their armor set
[*] Lifeforms with the bleed status effect will now leave behind a trail of blood
[*] Added new home decorations
[*] Added new items
[*] Added new item artwork for some existing items
[*] Added new popup icons for interactions
[*] Added new weapons
[*] Added new armour
[*] Added new introduction for beginners
[*] Added new artwork for all existing home furniture/units
[*] Added two new skill types
[*] Added consoles throughout the Badlands that you can hack for experience points
[*] Added Acadia's blessing status effect (grants 10 seconds of immunity when you spawn in)
[*] Added new enemy type to the Badlands: Androids
[*] Added new blood/gore effects
[*] Added screen shake modifier setting
[*] Added enable combat effects setting
[*] Added flash effect for taking damage
[*] Added immunity shield when extracting
[*] Updated audio system for more immersive directional audio
[/list]


🐜 If you encounter any bugs, please report them inside the [url=https://discord.gg/dead-unicorn-772603203246227547]Discord server[/url].


[b]👇 Lastly, don't forget to Wishlist Blood Running and follow us on social media! 👇[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2641490/Blood_Running/
